title: The 5M: Correction #1
hook: After BOS #1, price pulls back. That pullback is Correction #1, and it never creates the zone.

launchpad.outcome: Identify Correction #1 on the 5M after BOS #1, and explain why it never creates the execution zone.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What is Correction #1, and why isn’t it the zone?

takeaways: Correction #1 is the 5M corrective move after BOS #1.
Preferably, it pulls back toward the original 15M break.
Correction #1 never creates the execution zone. Correction #2 does.
If BOS #2 never happens, the sequence is incomplete. No trade.
remember: CORRECTION #1 IS A PULLBACK. NEVER THE ZONE.

slides.headline: After BOS #1, the 5M takes over.
slides.line: The first 5M pullback after BOS #1 is Correction #1. Learn to spot it, and learn what it’s not.

steps.caption: On the 5M, price keeps pushing higher after BOS #1.
Correction #1. Price pulls back on the 5M, toward the original 15M break.
Correction #1 never creates the execution zone. It’s only the first pullback.

options.label: Yes, mark it as demand

options.label: No, Correction #1 never creates the zone
options.why: Right. The zone comes later, from Correction #2.

slides.headline: Correction #1 or #2? Know the difference.
slides.line: The sequence has two corrections. Only one of them creates the zone.

versus.label: Correction #1
points: Preferably pulls back toward the 15M break.

options.label: Correction #1
options.feedback: Correction #1 never creates the execution zone. It comes before BOS #2.

options.label: Correction #2
options.why: Right. Correction #2 creates the zone, and BOS #3 activates it.

slides.headline: Correction #1 formed. Then what?
slides.line: Bearish example. Press the button and watch what the 5M does after Correction #1.

steps.caption: BOS #1. A 15M candle closes below the 15M level.
Correction #1. Price pulls back up toward the 15M break.
Price never closes below the low Correction #1 pulled back from. BOS #2 never happens.

check.prompt: BOS #2 never happened. Is there a trade here?

options.label: Yes, sell from Correction #1
options.feedback: Correction #1 never creates the execution zone, and BOS #2 never happened. The sequence is incomplete.

options.label: No, the sequence is incomplete
options.why: Right. Without BOS #2, there’s no Correction #2, no zone and no trade.

slides.quote: Correction #1 is a pullback. It’s never the zone.

slides.prompt: In your own words, what is Correction #1, and why don’t you trade from it?
slides.modelAnswer: Correction #1 is the 5M corrective move after BOS #1, preferably back toward the original 15M break. It never creates the execution zone. The zone comes from Correction #2, after BOS #2, and BOS #3 has to activate it before the retest matters.
